svg.title: Architecture evolution — Week 1 to Week 4
svg.desc: Two structural diagrams showing infrastructure evolution from a manually provisioned VM in Week 1 to a fully Terraform-managed Azure platform with ACR, Key Vault, and monitoring in Week 4
svg.text: One service, everything by hand, no automation

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How did internet traffic reach the app in Week 1?')
sendPrompt('What NSG rules existed in Week 1?')
sendPrompt('How was the voting app deployed in Week 1?')
sendPrompt('Why did voting fail in Week 1?')
sendPrompt('What was missing from the Week 1 architecture?')
g.text: No IaC · No Docker · No CI/CD · No secrets mgmt

svg.text: All infrastructure as code · reproducible in minutes

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does internet traffic reach the app in Week 4?')
sendPrompt('Why is the AKS subnet so large?')
sendPrompt('What do the NSG rules enforce in Week 4?')
sendPrompt('What is ACR and why is admin_enabled false?')
sendPrompt('Why use Key Vault instead of .env files?')
sendPrompt('What flows into the Log Analytics Workspace?')
sendPrompt('Why is Terraform state in Azure Blob?')
g.text: Azure Blob · versioning · locking · no .tfstate in Git
